question: What does the ILPA Due Diligence Questionnaire 2.0 ask about GP-led secondaries and continuation funds in Section 6?
expected_facts: Section 6.0 opens with two Yes/No screening questions. 6.1 asks whether the Firm has done a GP-led secondary in the last five years, and 6.2 asks the same for a continuation fund transaction. acceptance: Accept a concise summary covering transaction history, four screening follow-ups, conflicts/disclosure and information, legal/economic/LP options, rationale, bidding/valuation, fees/carry and related deals. Exact subquestion numbering and every illustrative detail are optional.
